topArticle.title: US grants deportation reprieve to migrants from Ukraine and Sudan

DHS says migrants ‘retain protections’ after temporary protected status was set to expire on Monday

Send us your questions about immigration and the midterms

More than 100,000 people from Ukraine and Sudan can stay in the United States without immediate risk of deportation, the Department of Homeland Security said, in what amounts to a temporary reprieve after their right to stay in the country was set to expire on Monday.
Temporary protected status was set to end on Monday for about 101,000 Ukrainians and 1,800 Sudanese. But the DHS said an announcement “will be made at the appropriate time”. Until then, the department said in a written statement, Ukrainians and Sudanese in the US covered by those temporary measures “retain protection”. The department did not indicate how long they could stay or when a final announcement would be made on their status.

topArticle.title: Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods
topArticle.description:
Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece
In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday.
Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico. By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted.

topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルが工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚から排除しようと奮闘する方法
topArticle.summary: エクアドルは、健康推進団体からの圧力を受け、工業用トランス脂肪酸の規制と施行のギャップに直面しながらも、食品棚からの排除を目指している。

topArticle.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
topArticle.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.
topArticle.titleJa: 世界トップクラスのイベントで知られる日本、だがアジア競技大会は混沌としたものだった
topArticle.summary: 日本の「アジア競技大会」は、ホテルや交通の混乱、外交上の失態が相次ぎ、主催者と運営会社の対応に注目が集まった。

topArticle.title: Borneo burning: Life on the frontline of South East Asia's toxic haze
topArticle.description: A "Super El Niño" has fuelled months-long fires in Indonesia, making hundreds of thousands of people sick.
topArticle.titleJa: 燃えるボルネオ：東南アジアの有害な煙害の最前線での生活
topArticle.summary: 「スーパーエルニーニョ」が数ヶ月にわたるインドネシアの火災を悪化させ、有害な煙害により数十万人を病気にしている。

topArticle.title: Pakistan arrests man wanted by US over $126m postage fraud case
topArticle.description: Faheem Akram allegedly sold more than 5 million fake postage labels for a fixed price of $2 a piece.
topArticle.titleJa: パキスタン、1億2600万ドルの郵便詐欺事件で米国が指名手配していた男を逮捕
topArticle.summary: 偽の郵便ラベルを500万枚以上販売し、1億2600万ドルの詐欺に関与した疑いで、米国が指名手配していた男がパキスタンで逮捕された。

topArticle.title: The Philippines launches safeguard investigation on pork
topArticle.description: On 21 October 2026, the Philippines notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of pork.
topArticle.titleJa: フィリピン、豚肉のセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: フィリピンは2026年10月9日、豚肉輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
topArticle.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
topArticle.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉が開始
topArticle.summary: 政府調達委員会で、東ティモールが政府調達協定（GPA）への加盟交渉を開始するために必要な主要文書を提出したことが歓迎されました。

topArticle.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
topArticle.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の菓子類に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは2026年10月9日、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート・ココア菓子の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: WTO-ITC visit to Mogadishu supports Somalia's preparations for next phase of WTO accession
topArticle.description: The WTO and the International Trade Centre (ITC) conducted their first joint technical assistance activity in Mogadishu, Somalia, from 10 to 15 October to support the government's preparations for the second meeting of the Working Party on the accession of Somalia. Supported by the United Kingdom, the technical assistance event also included discussions on regional integration and the forthcoming Trade for Peace Somalia Initiative.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO-ITC、ソマリアのWTO加盟準備を支援するためモガディシュを訪問
topArticle.summary: WTOと国際貿易センターは、ソマリアのWTO加盟作業部会次期会合への準備を支援するため、モガディシュで初の共同技術支援活動を実施しました。
